Ken Heebner increased its stake in Biogen Inc (BIIB) by 138.04% Capital Planning Advisors Llc bought 1,564 shares as the company’s stock declined 17.01% with the market. The hedge fund run by Ken Heebner held 2,697 shares of the biological products (no diagnostic substances) company at the end of 2017Q4, valued at $859,000, up from 1,133 at the end of the previous reported quarter. Capital Planning Advisors Llc who had been investing in Biogen Inc $57.04 billion market cap company. The stock increased 1.46% or $3.9 during the last trading session, reaching $270.34. About 1.66 million shares traded. Biogen Inc. (NASDAQ:BIIB) has declined 3.66% 15.21% the S&P500.
Bbr Partners Llc decreased its stake in Albemarle Corp (ALB) by 40.37% Bbr Partners Llc sold 6,587 shares as the company’s stock declined 27.74% with the market. The hedge fund held 9,731 shares of the major chemicals company at the end of 2017Q4, valued at $1.24M, down from 16,318 at the end of the previous reported quarter. Bbr Partners Llc who had been investing in Albemarle Corp for a number of months, seems to be less bullish one the $11.08 billion market cap company. The stock increased 2.22% or $2.17 during the last trading session, reaching $100.06. About 1.29M shares traded. Albemarle Corporation (NYSE:ALB) has declined 10.68% 22.23% the S&P500.
Bbr Partners Llc, which manages about $7.35 billion and $561.72 million US Long portfolio, upped its stake in Apple Inc (NASDAQ:AAPL) by 17,282 shares to 27,531 shares, valued at $4.66M in 2017Q4, according to the filing. It also increased its holding in Ellington Financial Llc (NYSE:EFC) by 380,000 shares in the quarter, for a total of 1.21 million shares, and has risen its stake in Procter & Gamble Co (NYSE:PG).
